title: Implement complete typed relationship pattern contracts
description:
Own the single reviewed typed IR addition needed by native pattern execution and complete Cypher read lowering. Add borrowed exact-name OR relationship type alternatives to fixed/bounded expansion and a nonleaking current-edge scope plus typed per-edge predicate to bounded expansion. Empty alternatives mean unrestricted; duplicate alternatives cannot multiply rows. Every candidate edge is tested before entering a path; null rejects; zero-hop evaluates no edge predicate. Preserve full IDs, 16-hop cap, one PatternId across comma parts of a MATCH and fresh PatternId on next MATCH, relationship uniqueness, stored original endpoints and bags. Specify and prove OptionalApply correlated anchor/rebinding and reused-variable equality/reprojection without overwriting existing slots.

Own query/plan/mod.rs, validate/expression/lineage and narrow graph_query_plan tests. Coordinate ordinal NodeFacts accessor with the relational owner; no competing graph execution or parser. Add a compiled scoped consumer of final BoundQuery -> actual charged PlanDescription/fact Vec -> validated GraphPlan with source spans and nonescaping borrows, including OR/per-edge/optional/projection shape. This is a contract tracer, not full lowering. RED malformed/foreign scope, wrong name backing, unreachable predicate, overlong hop, omitted alternative/per-edge check; GREEN exact structured facts/barriers, same-account peak/cancel cleanup and lifetime checks. Freeze the exact compiled API and commit hash before downstream lowering starts. No physical graph execution or original TCK pass claim.

title: Implement bounded native adjacency codecs and merging
description:
Own storage/adjacency code for versioned immutable bases/deltas and bounded sorted merge/consolidation partition kernels. Consume exact typed NodeId/RelId/RelTypeId, direction, half-open RelId range with tagged infinity, base plus at most eight borrowed sorted delta runs, and caller-owned bounded output. Full u128 numeric IDs; <=4096 base entries, <=2048 pending entries, private consolidation required before ninth run/2049th pending entry. Preserve delete neighbor identity; newer committed sequence wins; equal-sequence identical observations may coalesce but conflicting actions/neighbors fail loudly. Validate every input/run/header/order/uniqueness/range before yielding any row. No hidden heap, tree lookup, VFS publication or relaxed caller budget. Poll actual validation/comparison/merge/copy sites, at least each entry and <=64KiB bytes, propagate typed format/limit/control errors, and mark partial scratch invalid on failure.

Storage owner reviewed boundary and reserves outer block tags13 adjacency base /14 adjacency delta (ZE43 owns11 payload chunk /12 provenance). Coordinate append-only kind decoding; own exact hand-written inner encoding/version and byte goldens in this commit. No registry ID collision or new dependencies. Tree descriptors, authoritative records, current-view endpoint liveness, real OUT/IN preparation and publication are still ZE44/45. Tests must cover sparse/empty ranges, high IDs/max-ID tagged infinity, 4097 split, ninth-run/2049-entry trigger, mixed insert/delete/property-only no-op, same-sequence conflict, truncation/corruption/cancellation, allocation-free hot merge and independent exact edge oracle. Deliberately ignore delete/drop a reverse-model entry to prove comparator detection; local paired direction model is not whole actual participant evidence. ## Reviewed sequence and topology freeze

Use native WAL u64 commit sequence (not GraphGeneration). Base/range has explicit consolidation watermark and merge input an explicit committed cutoff: watermark <= cutoff; every run satisfies watermark < sequence <= cutoff; run order is nondecreasing. Exact equal-sequence duplicate observations may coalesce but conflicting actions/neighbors reject. All occurrences of a RelId across all sequences/base must preserve the same neighbor, even when newest observation is a delete. Kernel checks complete supplied group; ZE44 binds cutoff/watermark to real admitted roots and authoritative cross-group topology. Pin storage of watermark/sequence in exact format and malformed goldens. Inner error/control transport is nonallocating (current FormatError owns String). Do not call uncontrolled outer ArtifactFrame decoding then claim bounded cancellation. Full validation plus final checkpoint occurs before valid output; no callback may publish early rows.

title: Implement bounded relational operators and eligible sets
description:
Own production filter/project/scope/aggregate/distinct/sort/offset/limit kernels and immutable same-view EligibleNodeSet using landed QueryValue semantics, RuntimeContext/QueryMemory, real fixed backing and cumulative counters. First compile a composed multi-operator/multi-batch tracer: existing generic PullOperator lifetimes must compose with retained buffers without unsafe widening. Define a charged ordered SlotId schema; logical slot is never a column index. Any required physical-operator execution-lifetime adaptation is owned here and reviewed before consumers; preserve existing driver barriers and no partial rows. Blocking row storage is a separately charged owner; never raise the256 scheduling-batch cap. Query expression data reads require actual later producer; controlled typed inputs prove kernels only.

Implement and independently verify empty global0/[] vs empty grouped, count/collect null skipping, DISTINCT null/NaN/exact mixed numeric/list equivalence including collision checks, bounded stable explicit sorting/ordered collect, WITH scopes, three-valued filtering, bags, offset/limit across many batches. EligibleNodeSet has private fields, same actual QueryView identity and one real packed NodeId arena; <=524288 total elements per list value (including nested descendants) and <=524288 materialized IDs per set; cumulative examined duplicate rows remain separately counted actual work, not a new cap, sorted unique full IDs, explicit AllIndexed versus empty. Charge simultaneous input/copy/scratch capacities; consume dead storage only through genuine owner transfer. Poll sorting/hashing/copy, count actual work, preserve surrounding bags, validate every member and view. No all-null/default entity accessor, synthetic budget credit or loose error collapse. Runtime entity/storage errors remain typed when integrated. Own query/relational and eligibility modules, minimal runtime/batch/schema additions and tests. ZE123 alone owns any new NodeFacts ordinal accessor; do not edit plan/mod.rs. Start schemas from explicit ordered distinct SlotIds verified using current facts.width()/slot(). Only consume a new accessor after its immutable compiled commit. ZE51 remains mandatory real ZE50/pattern/evaluator/structured-plan integration; ZE64 owns real ranking/eager reports.

title: Implement aligned graph response ownership and registration
description:
Own real aligned typed C result pools/root descriptor, private prepared registration, infallible expose transition and bounded validated free under ZE67 fixed schema. Guarantee alignment by actual allocation Layout/typed backing (Vec<u8> is insufficient); reserve/charge full actual padding/capacity before allocation. Private prepared owner holds genuine registry admission and complete authoritative pointer/count/type/generation/token geometry. Registry growth is real fallible precommit work; logical entry counts or HashMap capacity are not allocator-byte evidence. A dedicated bounded registry slab is allowed if it preserves legacy registry isolation and explicitly accounts whole backing. Expose only moves prepared ownership/sets known fields: no allocation, copying, hash insertion, formatting or fallible callback.

Free compares complete host-visible immutable geometry/token/type against registered owner and drops a bounded allocation set, never host-mutated recursive pointers. Empty descriptor second free succeeds; stale copied descriptor and changed pointers/counts/token/cross-kind fail without stealing real owner. Implement an independent outcome cell outside unwind scope: reads NotApplicable, potential writes Indeterminate before attempt, known committed generation survives panic/delivery failure/cancel. Only real coordinator determines durable outcome later. Internal prepare/expose/free can be tested now; shipping exports/header/default feature wiring remains coordinated ZE69/107.

Acceptance: real aligned pools/registry with independent descriptor oracle, graph/list/entity/string heap-flat loops, alignment on every typed array, empty/second/stale/forged frees, actual allocator denial during expose/free, all precommit failpoints clean, exact capacities and peak core/ABI overlap. Freeze compiled owner/reservation API before adapters. Do not cast ZE37 byte arenas or fake authentic charge transfer. ZE68 remains mandatory native-result conversion, actual receipt hook/aligned preparation adaptation, no graph lease after real close/reopen, true commit-window allocation denial and real coordinator outcome faults.
